name: SRT Replay
author: ChachizR
description: Receive, monitor, record, and clip SRT streams with a detachable player.

barWidget.description: SRT listener/caller with a docked preview, pop-out player, and one-click MKV recording.

schema.label: Connection mode
schema.description: listener waits for a sender (OBS, Larix, vMix) to connect; caller connects out to a remote SRT listener.

schema.label: Receiver latency (ms)
schema.description: Higher values survive lossy links at the cost of delay. SRT uses the larger of both peers' values.

schema.label: Replay buffer for clips
schema.description: Keeps the last 75 s of the stream in RAM (about 110 MB at 12 Mb/s) so the panel's clip buttons can save the last 10 s to 1 min. Clips go to <recordings>/Clips.

schema.label: Clip hotkeys (1, 2, 3, 6)
schema.description: While a stream is live, keys 1/2/3/6 save the last 10 s/20 s/30 s/1 min from any app. The digits don't type in other apps while active.
